source_title: Lockie Ferguson ruled out of New Zealand vs India T20I series; Replacement named - Sportstar
source_excerpt:
FILE PHOTO: Ferguson was involved in the first and second matches, picking up just one wicket across the two fixtures. | Photo Credit: AP
Pacer Lockie Ferguson has been ruled out of remainder of New Zealand’s five-match home T20I series against visiting India, New Zealand Cricket announced.
“Ferguson experienced pain in his right-calf during the second T20I at Hagley Oval and subsequent scans confirmed a low-grade tear, and he is expected to require another week or so of recovery before returning to play,” the Board said in a release.
Ferguson was involved in the first and second matches, picking up just one wicket across the two fixtures.
Matt Fisher has been named as Ferguson’s replacement for the 4th and 5th T20Is. Meanwhile, Central Stags fast-bowler Brett Randell has been called up to the New Zealand A squad for the second unofficial Test against India A to replace Fisher.
Moreover, Matt Henry was also assessed after he experienced discomfort after the second T20I. “Scans have shown he’s picked up a low-grade tear requiring one-to-two weeks recovery,” the release added.

New Zealand head coach Rob Walter said he was optimistic Ferguson and Henry would be involved in the ODIs against India.
“We’re gutted for Lockie and Matt,” said Walter. “Injuries are part and parcel of international cricket but it doesn’t make it any easier when you have to miss games.
“Fortunately for Matt he was already going to sit out on the rest of the T20Is with an eye to his big summer schedule, and we’re hopeful he’ll still play a key role in the ODIs.
“I know Lockie was fizzing to play in front of a sell-out home crowd at Eden Park tomorrow, but he’s determined to be back for the ODIs.”
India has taken an unassailable 3-0 lead in the five-match T20I series after the Men in Blue notched up a six-wicket win in the third match in Wellington.

न्यूजीलैंड क्रिकेट की घोषणा के अनुसार, तेज गेंदबाज लॉकी फर्ग्यूसन दाहिने बछड़े की चोट के कारण भारत के खिलाफ शेष घरेलू पांच मैचों की टी20 श्रृंखला से बाहर हो गए हैं। हेगले ओवल में दूसरे टी20 मैच के दौरान उन्हें दर्द महसूस हुआ था, जिसके बाद स्कैन में लो-ग्रेड टियर की पुष्टि हुई। उनके लगभग एक सप्ताह में ठीक होने की उम्मीद है। चौथे और पांचवें टी20 मैच के लिए मैट फिशर को उनका विकल्प नामित किया गया है।

## टीम अपडेट और चोट की स्थिति
* **लॉकी फर्ग्यूसन:** दाहिने बछड़े में लो-ग्रेड टियर के कारण शेष टी20 मैचों से बाहर।
* **मैट फिशर:** अंतिम दो मैचों के लिए फर्ग्यूसन के विकल्प के रूप में टी20 टीम में शामिल।
* **मैट हेनरी:** दूसरे टी20 के बाद उन्हें भी लो-ग्रेड टियर हुआ, जिसके लिए एक से दो सप्ताह के पुनर्लाभ की आवश्यकता है।
* **ब्रेट रैंडेल:** फिशर के स्थान पर भारत ए के खिलाफ दूसरे अनधिकृत टेस्ट के लिए न्यूजीलैंड ए टीम में शामिल किए गए।

## श्रृंखला की स्थिति
वेलिंगटन में तीसरे मैच में छह विकेट से जीत दर्ज करने के बाद भारत ने पांच मैचों की टी20 श्रृंखला में 3-0 की अजय बढ़त बना ली है। न्यूजीलैंड के मुख्य कोच रॉब वाल्टर ने उम्मीद जताई है कि फर्ग्यूसन और हेनरी दोनों भारत के खिलाफ आगामी वनडे श्रृंखला के लिए समय पर ठीक हो जाएंगे। प्रशंसक न्यूजीलैंड क्रिकेट के आधिकारिक मीडिया चैनलों और प्रेस विज्ञप्तियों के माध्यम से आधिकारिक टीम घोषणाओं को सत्यापित कर सकते हैं।

en_body:
New Zealand fast bowler Lockie Ferguson has been ruled out for the remainder of the five-match home T20I series against India following a right-calf injury, according to an announcement by New Zealand Cricket. Scans confirmed a low-grade tear after he experienced pain during the second T20I at Hagley Oval, with a recovery period of approximately one week expected. Matt Fisher has been named as his replacement for the fourth and fifth T20Is.

## Squad Updates and Injury Statuses
* **Lockie Ferguson:** Ruled out of the remaining T20Is due to a low-grade right-calf tear.
* **Matt Fisher:** Added to the T20I squad as Ferguson's replacement for the final two matches.
* **Matt Henry:** Also diagnosed with a low-grade tear following the second T20I, requiring one to two weeks of recovery.
* **Brett Randell:** Called up to the New Zealand A squad for the second unofficial Test against India A to replace Fisher.

## Series Context and Outlook
India holds an unassailable 3-0 lead in the five-match T20I series following a six-wicket victory in the third match in Wellington. New Zealand head coach Rob Walter expressed optimism that both Ferguson and Henry could recover in time for the upcoming ODI series against India. Fans can verify official team announcements and squad updates directly through New Zealand Cricket's official media channels and press releases.
